skills/engineering/code-review.notes: Divergences: (1) the /setup-matt-pocock-skills fallback points at docs/agents/issue-tracker.md instead. (2) Step 3's "Always a judgement call" rule becomes "Fix or explain", pointing at docs/agents/verdicts.md; the Standards brief's judgement-call sentence becomes the same pointer, with the re-check of a kept smell's reason and a stale reason reported as a fresh smell. (3) Step 3 always adds docs/prose-style.md, the prose rules file, to the standards sources when the diff touches a `.md` file; a "Code only" rule in step 3, and the brief's matching sentence: prose findings cite the prose rules file, its smell baseline included, never the code baseline. The prose baseline stays in docs/prose-style.md, never pasted into the skill, since it is specific to this repo. (4) The Standards brief asks for each smell's "→ how to fix" line with the finding. (5) Step 4's opening sentence names the tool: call the Agent tool twice in one message, `subagent_type: "general-purpose"`, one per axis, since runner review sessions never spawned the reviewers when nothing named it. (6) Step 4 adds a verdict line both briefs end with, a suggested verdict and its reason for each finding under docs/agents/verdicts.md; step 5 presents each finding with it, and its no-merge sentence becomes keeping each finding under its own axis's heading in its reviewer's order.

skills/engineering/domain-modeling.notes: Divergences: (1) ADR-FORMAT.md's template ends with a required `Source:` line naming the backing issues as owner/repo#n and/or commits, plus a sentence saying it is required; SKILL.md adds a "Backlink the issue" section: the backing issue's body ends with `Design decision: <owner/repo>/docs/adr/NNNN-slug.md`, kept in step by docs/agents/issue-tracker.md. (2) SKILL.md adds, after "Offer ADRs sparingly", a paragraph pointing at the "What qualifies" list, writing only after a yes, and offering an ADR when the developer rejects a suggestion for a reason that bears weight; and a "Build principles on ADRs" section: an instance added to a principle's reasoning without asking as a link plus one clause, a pair proposed as a one-line principle and written only after approval, pair-spotting reading every ADR body with no index, a superseded ADR stops counting and a principle below two ADRs goes to the developer rather than being deleted, deliberate-absence bullets name the gap and its reason, and cross-repo citations only from a repo using the library, by absolute GitHub URL, and never from a private repo; it opens by naming the design docs that hold principles (packages/framework/docs/design.md, docs/agent-behavior-design.md) and the at-least-two-ADRs rule. (3) File structure: the multi-context tree shows one docs/adr/ per repo root (byro-repo root for agent behavior, packages/framework, packages/real-estate), not per context, and says packages/writing gets none.
